DECL Shao.OQ3.pair_projection_absolute_moment_bound
TYPE ∀ (law : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)) (m : ℕ),
  MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ m) law →
    ∀ (u v : ℝ),
      have f := fun y => |u * y 0 + v * y 1| ^ m;
      MeasureTheory.Integrable f law ∧
        0 ≤ ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), f y ∂law ∧
          ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), f y ∂law ≤ √(u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) ^ m * ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ m ∂law
AXIOMS [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
KIND theorem

DECL Shao.OQ3.uniform_standardized_pair_log_moment_approximation
TYPE ∀ {ι : Type u_1} (law : ι → MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)),
  (∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure (law i)) →
    (∀ (i : ι) (j : Fin 2), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => y j) 2 (law i)) →
      (∀ (i : ι) (j : Fin 2), ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), y j ∂law i = 0) →
        (∀ (i : ι) (j k : Fin 2),
            ProbabilityTheory.covariance (fun y => y j) (fun y => y k) (law i) = if j = k then 1 else 0) →
          ∀ (m : ℕ),
            1 ≤ m →
              ∀ (M3 Mm : ℝ),
                (∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ 3) (law i)) →
                  (∀ (i : ι), ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ 3 ∂law i ≤ M3) →
                    (∀ (i : ι), MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ m) (law i)) →
                      (∀ (i : ι), ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ m ∂law i ≤ Mm) →
                        have Phi := fun i u v =>
                          ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), Complex.exp (↑(u * y 0 + v * y 1) * Complex.I) ∂law i;
                        have P := fun i u v =>
                          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range m,
                            Complex.I ^ j / ↑j.factorial * ↑(∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), (u * y 0 + v * y 1) ^ j ∂law i);
                        have K2 := 2 + (Real.exp 1 + 4) * |M3|;
                        have Km := 1 + (Real.exp 1 + ↑m + 1) * |Mm|;
                        0 < K2 ∧
                          0 < Km ∧
                            ∃ delta,
                              0 < delta ∧
                                delta ≤ 1 ∧
                                  ∀ (i : ι) (u v : ℝ),
                                    √(u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) ≤ delta →
                                      ‖Phi i u v - 1‖ ≤ 1 / 2 ∧
                                        ‖P i u v - 1‖ ≤ 1 ∧
                                          ∀ (q : ℕ),
                                            ‖Complex.log (Phi i u v) - Complex.logTaylor (q + 1) (P i u v - 1)‖ ≤
                                              2 * (K2 * (u ^ 2 + v ^ 2)) ^ (q + 1) / ↑(q + 1) +
                                                ↑(q + 1) * Km * √(u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) ^ m
AXIOMS [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
KIND theorem

DECL Shao.OQ3.pair_probability_directional_first_two_moments
TYPE ∀ (law : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure law],
  (∀ (j : Fin 2), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => y j) 2 law) →
    (∀ (j : Fin 2), ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), y j ∂law = 0) →
      (∀ (j k : Fin 2), ProbabilityTheory.covariance (fun y => y j) (fun y => y k) law = if j = k then 1 else 0) →
        ∀ (u v : ℝ),
          have L := fun y => u * y 0 + v * y 1;
          MeasureTheory.MemLp L 2 law ∧
            MeasureTheory.Integrable L law ∧
              MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => L y ^ 2) law ∧
                ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), L y ∂law = 0 ∧ ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), L y ^ 2 ∂law = u ^ 2 + v ^ 2
AXIOMS [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
KIND theorem
DECL Shao.OQ3.pair_probability_degree_four_moment_polynomial
TYPE ∀ (law : MeasureTheory.Measure (Fin 2 → ℝ)) [MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure law],
  (∀ (j : Fin 2), MeasureTheory.MemLp (fun y => y j) 2 law) →
    (∀ (j : Fin 2), ∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), y j ∂law = 0) →
      (∀ (j k : Fin 2), ProbabilityTheory.covariance (fun y => y j) (fun y => y k) law = if j = k then 1 else 0) →
        MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ 3) law →
          MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => √(y 0 ^ 2 + y 1 ^ 2) ^ 4) law →
            ∀ (u v : ℝ),
              have L := fun y => u * y 0 + v * y 1;
              MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => L y ^ 3) law ∧
                MeasureTheory.Integrable (fun y => L y ^ 4) law ∧
                  ∑ j ∈ Finset.range 5, Complex.I ^ j / ↑j.factorial * ↑(∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), L y ^ j ∂law) =
                    1 - ↑(u ^ 2 + v ^ 2) / 2 - Complex.I * ↑(∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), L y ^ 3 ∂law) / 6 +
                      ↑(∫ (y : Fin 2 → ℝ), L y ^ 4 ∂law) / 24
AXIOMS [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
KIND theorem

DECL Shao.OQ3.complex_log_taylor_quartic_correction_bound
TYPE ∀ (a b c : ℂ) (r A B C : ℝ),
  0 ≤ r →
    r ≤ 1 →
      0 ≤ A →
        0 ≤ B →
          0 ≤ C →
            ‖a‖ ≤ A * r ^ 2 →
              ‖b‖ ≤ B * r ^ 3 →
                ‖c‖ ≤ C * r ^ 4 →
                  ‖Complex.logTaylor 3 (a + b + c) - (a + b + c - a ^ 2 / 2)‖ ≤ (A * (B + C) + (B + C) ^ 2) * r ^ 5
AXIOMS [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
KIND theorem
